summary: Defines a link-type sub-TLV for OSPF and IS-IS that tells how many traffic engineering label switched paths with zero reserved bandwidth cross a link. Using this count, a path computation can make better statistical guesses about the real load on a link. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Some cars reserve no seats but still ride the bus. This lets a router report how many of these unreserved riders are on each road, so planners get a better idea of how crowded it is.

questions: number of zero bandwidth te lsps
ospf is-is sub-tlv unreserved lsp count
